scientific_integrity: A complete direct combinatorial proof and finite independent trace-enumeration checks are supplied; finite tests are not used as an infinite proof. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns radius-one closed-neighborhood traces of triangular graphs J(n,2), n>=2, and does not extend by assertion to open neighborhoods, Johnson graphs of higher rank, or general line graphs. Published priority under unsearched synonyms remains uncertain.
title: Exact closed-neighborhood shattering profiles of triangular graphs
